doc: M2-UI-28: the debug pseudo-localisation (docs/kb/tech/ui.md 'Pseudo-localisation'). Debug builds only (game/core/debug/pseudo_loc.gd, which release exports strip). Every source-locale string of the loc CSVs is rewritten into a translation for `locale`: letters swapped for accented ones (`accents`), each line padded by `expansion` of its visible length in `pad_char` groups of `pad_group` after a space, the whole string between `prefix` and `suffix`. {placeholders}, %-formats, BBCode tags and newlines are copied untouched. Turned on by the `flag` launch argument (after `--` or before it), by the `env_var` environment variable (any value but 0 or false), or by `toggle_key` in the debug overlay. Godot's own pseudolocalization is not used: it accents {placeholders} and BBCode tags, so String.format and RichTextLabel markup break.
